draft_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling decodes faster than Talmar, with a median latency of 41 vs 118 ms per utterance.
revised_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling's median latency was 41 ms per utterance versus 118 ms reported for Talmar, though the two were measured on different accelerators (Corvex A2 fp16 vs Corvex A1 fp32).
rationale: Numbers 41 and 118 match T1.r1.lat and T1.r2.lat. However, the latencies were measured under different conditions: Brisling on Corvex A2 fp16 (this work), Talmar on Corvex A1 fp32 from its paper. The comparison "decodes faster" is only as strong as comparability; the package notes the differing setups, so the claim should reflect this limitation.
